title: 第20章 要被开除了
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
过了大约十来分钟，高跟鞋的声音“哒哒哒”响起，显然来得人很是匆忙。

    原本冷眼看着郁凌的冯健顿时来了精神，“我妈来了，你们惨了！”

    办公室门“啪”的一声被打开了。

    “我儿子呢？谁敢打我儿子？”尖锐的声音从门口传来。

    所有人看了过去，一个身材较为矮小略微丰满的女人穿着一件黑色的紧身连衣裙，肚子上那游泳圈若隐若现，显然衣服绷得有些辛苦。

    脸上浓妆艳抹，鲜红的口红涂在嘴唇上，像一个吃小孩的虎姑婆。

    看到冯健的妈妈，其他人都忍不住一震，卧槽，冯健这么大个个子，为啥妈妈这么矮？

    冯健的妈妈一看到自家孩子那脸上的青紫，便冲了过去，宝贝儿子的叫了起来，可心疼坏了。

    随后转身对着教导主任就是一连串的质问。

    “刘主任，怎么回事？为什么我儿子会被人打？你都不知道阻止的吗？”。

    冯健连忙跟他妈告状：“妈，就是这人打的我，都是他，你让舅舅把他赶出学校。”

    曹菊听到这话，看向郁凌，大步走了过去，举起手便想给他一巴掌：“你这没教养的小畜生，居然敢打我儿子。”

    手还没挥下去，便被抓住了。

    郁凡阴沉着脸看着她，“这位女士，我建议你最好放尊重一点。”

    要不是自己不打女人，真想一脚把她给踹飞出去。

    曹菊挣脱不开郁凡的钳制，顿时尖叫不已，“你这下等人居然敢碰我，刘主任，你瞎眼了，还不来帮我！”

    事实上，所有人都呆愣住了，刚才他们只看到一道黑影闪了过去，然后便是冯健他妈妈的尖叫声。

    郁凌他哥的速度好快啊。

    站在两侧的学生不由得感叹着。

    刘主任此时才被曹菊的叫声震醒。

    他现在只觉得自己头疼，冯健的妈妈可不是一个好惹的，曾经有学生和冯健产生争执，被他妈知道后，可是狠狠打了那孩子几巴掌不说，还让曹董将那学生给开除了学籍并留下了不好的记录，随后那家人在海市也被冯家和曹家双重打压，最后被迫无奈，只能到外地去谋求生存。

    这事因为闹的比较大，不少学生都知道了冯健不好惹，都是能躲就躲着。
content_en:
After about ten minutes, the sound of high-heeled shoes "ta-ta-ta-ta" sounded. It was obvious that the person arrived in a hurry.

Feng Jian, who had been looking at Yu Ling coldly, suddenly became energetic and said, "My mother is here, you are in trouble!"

The office door opened with a bang.

"Where is my son? Who dares to hit my son?" A sharp voice came from the door.

Everyone looked over and saw a short and plump woman wearing a black tight-fitting dress. The swimming ring on her belly was looming. It was obvious that the clothes were stretched too hard.

The face is heavily made up, and bright red lipstick is smeared on the lips, like a tiger aunt eating children.

Seeing Feng Jian's mother, everyone else couldn't help being shocked. Damn it, Feng Jian is so big, why is his mother so short?

As soon as Feng Jian's mother saw the bruises on her child's face, she rushed over. Her precious son screamed, but she was heartbroken.

Then he turned to the dean and asked a series of questions.

"Director Liu, what's going on? Why was my son beaten? Didn't you know how to stop it?"

Feng Jian quickly complained to his mother: "Mom, this person is the one who beat me. You asked your uncle to kick him out of school."

When Cao Ju heard this, she looked at Yu Ling, strode over, raised her hand and wanted to slap him: "You uncultured little beast, how dare you hit my son."

Before he could swing his hand, he was caught.

Yu Fan looked at her sullenly, "Madam, I suggest you be more respectful."

If he hadn't hit the woman, he would have kicked her out.

Cao Ju couldn't break free from Yu Fan's grip and screamed, "How dare you, a low-class person like you, touch me? Director Liu, you are blind and why don't you come and help me!"

In fact, everyone was stunned. Just now they only saw a black shadow flashing past, and then the scream of Feng Jian's mother.

Yu Ling's brother is so fast.

The students standing on both sides couldn't help but sigh.

Director Liu was only awakened by Cao Ju's cry at this time.

He just feels like he has a headache now. Feng Jian's mother is not someone to be trifled with. There was once a student who had a dispute with Feng Jian. When his mother found out, she slapped the child several times and asked Director Cao to expel the student from school and leave a bad record. Later, the family was also suppressed by the Feng family and the Cao family in Haishi. In the end, they were forced to have no choice but to seek survival in other places.

Because this matter was such a big deal, many students knew that Feng Jian was not to be trifled with, so they avoided him whenever they could.
